mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_NOTICES (ALARM_ID, USER_ID, NOTICE_ID, IS_READ) VALUES (SEQ_ALARM_ID.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{noticeId}, 'N')
mapper.select: SELECT A.ALARM_ID, A.USER_ID, A.NOTICE_ID, A.IS_READ, A.REG_DT, N.TITLE FROM USER_NOTICES A JOIN SYSTEM_NOTICES N ON A.NOTICE_ID = N.NOTICE_ID WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC
